title: chenopodium album subsp. ficifolium
intro: Chenopodium album subsp. ficifolium, commonly known as Lamb's Quarters or Fat Hen, is a plant species belonging to the Amaranthaceae family, characterized by its edible leaves and stems. The plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lamb's Quarters include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and support digestive health, likely due to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lamb's Quarters include flavonoids, carotenoids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
